question: Should PR #100383 be allowed to close #98650, or should the closing reference be removed so the broader native-hook/Codex outage issue stays open?
rationale: The code evidence supports a relay registration race fix, but the linked issue appears broader than the proved change and GitHub would auto-close it on merge.

options.title: Keep #98650 open
options.body: Remove or rewrite the closing reference before merge and treat this PR as a partial reliability fix for the native-hook relay path.

options.title: Accept closure
options.body: Merge with the closing reference only if a maintainer decides the current proof is sufficient for the full #98650 outage scope.
